settings.title: Session replay and heatmaps
settings.desc: Both stay off until you turn them on here. Your site only downloads the recorder when replay is on.
settings.adminsOnly: Only admins can change these settings.
settings.enableHelp: Records what visitors see and do on your site so you can watch it back. Form fields are always masked, and elements with the class zs-no-capture or ph-no-capture are left out. Recordings are kept for 30 days, or for the project retention if that is shorter. Tell your visitors about it in your privacy policy.
settings.sampleRateHelp: Decided per session: a session is recorded whole or not at all.
settings.maskTextHelp: Replaces every piece of text on the page with asterisks in the recording. With this off, page text is recorded, including anything typed into contenteditable areas.
settings.heatmapsHelp: Adds the position of each click and the scroll depth of each page view to your events. Clicks outside links and buttons are also recorded as events, which count toward your event volume.
settings.heatmapsNeedsAutocapture: Heatmaps need click autocapture, and it is off for this project. Turn it on above for this setting to take effect.

recordings.title: Recordings
recordings.description: Watch what visitors did on your site.
recordings.offBody: Turn it on in the project settings to start recording sessions. Nothing is recorded until you do.
recordings.offBodyMember: Nothing is being recorded for this project. Ask an admin of your workspace to turn on session replay.
recordings.offNotice: Session replay is off, so nothing new is being recorded. Existing recordings stay until they expire.
recordings.offNoticeMember: Session replay is off, so nothing new is being recorded. An admin can turn it back on.
recordings.emptyBody: Session replay is on. Recordings appear here shortly after someone visits a page with the snippet installed. Check the sample rate and allowed domains in the project settings if none show up.
recordings.deleteBody: The recording is removed for good. The events of the session stay in Analytics.
recordings.personOff: Session replay is off for this project.
recordings.personOffMember: Session replay is off for this project. An admin can turn it on.
recordings.adminsOnlyBody: Recordings can show what people do on the site, so they are limited to workspace admins. Ask an admin if you need one.

player.error: The recording didn't load. Try again.
player.unplayable: This recording has no starting snapshot, so it cannot be played.
player.keys: Space plays, arrows move 5 seconds, Esc goes back
player.active: {seconds, plural, one {# second active} other {# seconds active}}

heatmaps.title: Heatmaps
heatmaps.description: Where people click and how far they scroll, page by page.
heatmaps.offBody: Turn them on in the project settings to start collecting click positions and scroll depth.
heatmaps.offBodyMember: No heatmap data is being collected for this project. Ask an admin of your workspace to turn on heatmaps.
heatmaps.emptyBody: Pages appear here once the snippet sends page views. Clicks are drawn only from the moment heatmaps were turned on.
heatmaps.ignored: {n, plural, one {# click with invalid values ignored.} other {# clicks with invalid values ignored.}}
heatmaps.frameRefused: This site does not allow being shown inside another page, so clicks are drawn over a plain background.
heatmaps.frameUnknown: We could not check whether this site can be shown here. If the area stays blank, the site does not allow it.
heatmaps.noFrame: We have no valid address for this page, so clicks are drawn over a plain background.
heatmaps.noClicks: No clicks on this page and screen size in this period.
heatmaps.scrollViews: {n, plural, one {# page view} other {# page views}}
heatmaps.noScroll: No scroll data on this page and screen size in this period.
heatmaps.error: Heatmap data didn't load. Try again.
